05/23/2023: Station Maintenance:                                         [1440] 
 
            - routine station maintenance, including: 
               - checked anemometer (bearings sound good) 
               - checked atmp/relh sensor (good) 
               - checked battery (13.09V) 
               - checked pyranometer (adjusted level) 
               - checked soil sensor cables (good) 
               - checked solar panel (19.9V) 
               - cleaned battery box 
               - replaced leaf wetness sensor [standard]* 
 
               * site does not include a canopy sensor

02/09/2015: System Maintenance:                                         [1210] 
 
            - hourly data-collection still having issues: 
               - reconfigured data-collection to dump to three separate 
                 files (one for each data-type: five-minute, hourly, and 
                 daily) instead of using a single file.   
               - reloaded logger program "bbaa-kzo" 
 
 
02/05/2015: System Maintenance:                                         [1230] 
 
            - replaced logger: 
               - previous logger continued to experience trouble with  
                 the collection of the hourly data tables.  The logger 
                 was replaced which will hopefully help to correct the 
                 problem. 
 
 
01/20/2015: System Maintenance:                                         [1200] 
 
            - logger having troubles properly dumping hourly data table 
              on a consistent basis.  In hopes of temporarily helping the 
              situation, reloaded logger program "bbaa-kzo").

09/24/2008: Station Online: 
 
            - Station added to MAWN web site. 
 
 
 
09/19/2008: Data Collection Enabled: 
 
            - Data Collection and Data Archive for new station begins: 
 
                 First data report:   Sep 20, 2008 - 00:05 (Day=264) 
 
 
 
09/17/2008: Station Maintenance: 
 
            - Established telecommunication between station cell-modem and 
              data collection PC/server on campus.    
 
            - Loaded MAWN Program:   BBC-KZO 
                                         B => CR1000 
                                         B => CS616  
                                         C => Broadband Cell Modem (IP) 
                                       KZO => Station ID (Kalamazoo) 
                                        
 
            - Now able to collect raw weather data.
